linkedin.account.cap: {cap, number} profiles a day at most
linkedin.account.disconnect_confirm: Whytide deletes its reference to this account and stops reading with it. Remove the account from the provider's console as well.
linkedin.account.reconnect: The provider needs you to sign in to LinkedIn again. Reconnect this account through the provider's page: read the disclosure below, tick both boxes and press Connect.
linkedin.account.waiting: The provider has not confirmed the connection yet. This page checks again by itself.
linkedin.accounts.empty: You have not connected a LinkedIn account in this workspace yet.
linkedin.accounts.error: Your LinkedIn account could not be loaded.
linkedin.connect.acknowledge: I have read this and accept it.
linkedin.connect.disclosure: Whytide reads LinkedIn through your own account, which you connect on the provider's page: Whytide never sees your password. It reads the profiles of the people who engage with the posts you choose, up to your daily read limit. It sends from your account only the connection requests and messages you approve, one by one, within fixed daily limits and inside your working hours. The account must be your own personal LinkedIn account, used by you alone. LinkedIn may still restrict an account it finds automated: connect yours only if you accept that risk.
linkedin.connect.failed: The connection did not complete. Try again.
linkedin.connect.personal_account: This is my own personal LinkedIn account, and only I use it.
linkedin.connect.title: Connect your LinkedIn account
linkedin.controls.hint.manage_only: Only members who manage LinkedIn accounts can pause or resume it.
linkedin.controls.hint.owner_only: Only the account's owner can resume it.
linkedin.controls.lift.confirm_body: Whytide may read and send in this workspace again, each account inside its own working hours and daily limits.
linkedin.controls.locked.account: The operator paused this account. Only the operator can resume it.
linkedin.controls.locked.platform: The operator stopped every LinkedIn action on this Whytide instance. Only the operator can lift that stop.
linkedin.controls.locked.workspace: The operator stopped every LinkedIn action in this workspace. Only the operator can lift that stop.
linkedin.controls.pause.confirm_body: Whytide stops every LinkedIn action through this account from the next one, reads and sends, until you resume it.
linkedin.controls.pause.description: No reads and no sends through this account while it is paused.
linkedin.controls.pause.label: Pause this account
linkedin.controls.pause.on: Paused: no LinkedIn action runs through this account until it is resumed.
linkedin.controls.resume.confirm_body: Whytide may read and send through this account again, inside its working hours and daily limits.
linkedin.controls.stop.confirm_body: Whytide stops every LinkedIn action in this workspace from the next one, reads and sends, for every account, until you lift the stop.
linkedin.controls.stop.description: One switch for the whole workspace: every account stops reading and sending.
linkedin.controls.stop.error: The workspace's stop could not be loaded.
linkedin.controls.stop.label: Stop every LinkedIn action in this workspace
linkedin.controls.stop.on: Stopped: no LinkedIn action runs in this workspace until the stop is lifted.
linkedin.controls.stop.title: Stop everything
linkedin.disclosure.accepted: Disclosure accepted: this account may send what you approve.
linkedin.disclosure.notice: This account reads, but sends nothing until its owner accepts the risk disclosure for sending.
linkedin.disclosure.owner_only: Only the account's owner can accept the disclosure for sending.
linkedin.disclosure.title: Risk disclosure for sending
linkedin.errors.account_not_paused: This account is not paused after a LinkedIn warning: there is nothing to resume.
linkedin.errors.account_paused: LinkedIn warned about this account, so Whytide paused it: nothing runs through it until it is connected again or, after its cool-down, resumed.
linkedin.errors.account_stopped: This LinkedIn account is paused: nothing runs through it until it is resumed.
linkedin.errors.cooldown_active: The account's cool-down is not over yet: resume it once it ends.
linkedin.errors.daily_actions_cap_reache: The account's actions for today are used up: they wait for the next day.
linkedin.errors.disclosure_required: The risk disclosure comes first: read it and tick the boxes.
linkedin.errors.disclosure_version_inval: This page shows an older disclosure. Reload it, read the new one and accept it.
linkedin.errors.invite_cap_reached: The account's connection requests for today are used up: they wait for the next day.
linkedin.errors.invite_note_budget: The account's three invitations with a note this month are used: notes wait until the oldest is 30 days old.
linkedin.errors.invites_paused: Connection requests are paused, on this Whytide instance or for this account; messages still go out.
linkedin.errors.linkedin_hash_key_missin: The LinkedIn hash key is not set on this Whytide instance: ask the operator.
linkedin.errors.member_id_unknown: Whytide has not checked which LinkedIn account this is yet: sends wait until it has.
linkedin.errors.message_cap_reached: The account's messages for today are used up: they wait for the next day.
linkedin.errors.not_account_owner: Only the account's owner can do this.
linkedin.errors.outside_working_hours: Outside the account's working hours: reads and sends wait for the next window, and sends never go on a weekend.
linkedin.errors.pending_invites_over_lim: More than 400 of the account's invitations are pending on LinkedIn: connection requests wait until fewer are; messages still go out.
linkedin.errors.pending_invites_unknown: Whytide has no recent count of the account's pending invitations: connection requests wait for its daily check; messages still go out.
linkedin.errors.personal_account_require: Confirm that this is your own personal LinkedIn account, used by you alone.
linkedin.errors.platform_stopped: The operator stopped every LinkedIn action on this Whytide instance.
linkedin.errors.read_cap_invalid: The daily read limit must be a whole number from 1 to the highest allowed.
linkedin.errors.read_cap_reached: The account's daily read cap is reached: reads wait for the next day.
linkedin.errors.read_input_invalid: That quota request is not valid.
linkedin.errors.reconnect_required: After LinkedIn's security check, disconnect the account and connect it again before resuming it.
linkedin.errors.reservation_not_open: That reservation is unknown or settled already.
linkedin.errors.send_attempt_late: The send started too late and was not made: it is tried again after a check.
linkedin.errors.sender_account_exists: Your LinkedIn account is connected already. Disconnect it first.
linkedin.errors.sender_account_in_use: That LinkedIn account is connected already, by another member or in another workspace.
linkedin.errors.sender_account_not_found: That LinkedIn account is not in this workspace.
linkedin.errors.sending_closed: Sending is closed on this Whytide instance until the operator opens it.
linkedin.errors.status_check_required: Check the account's status first: resuming needs the provider's answer from the last 10 minutes.
linkedin.errors.stopped_by_operator: The operator set this stop: only the operator can lift it.
linkedin.errors.weekly_invite_cap_reache: The account's connection requests for this week are used up: they wait until the week leaves room.
linkedin.errors.withdrawal_cap_reached: The account's withdrawals for today are used up: they wait for the next day.
linkedin.errors.working_hours_invalid: Working hours need a start before the end, at least one day, and a known time zone.
linkedin.errors.workspace_stopped: Every LinkedIn action in this workspace is stopped until the stop is lifted.
linkedin.health.at_risk: Connection requests are paused: too few were accepted. They resume by themselves once 20% of the last 100 are.
linkedin.health.blocked.account_not_paus: Nothing to resume: the account is not paused after a warning.
linkedin.health.blocked.cooldown_active: Resume opens once the cool-down ends.
linkedin.health.blocked.linkedin_account: The account is not connected: connect it again first.
linkedin.health.blocked.not_account_owne: Only the account's owner can resume it.
linkedin.health.blocked.reconnect_requir: After the security check, disconnect the account and connect it again before resuming.
linkedin.health.blocked.status_check_req: Check the status first: Resume needs the provider's answer from the last 10 minutes.
linkedin.health.breaker: Connection requests are paused on every account of this Whytide instance until the operator reopens them. Messages still go out.
linkedin.health.check_slow: The provider has not answered yet. Try again in a few minutes.
linkedin.health.disconnected: The LinkedIn session was lost. Connect the account again below.
linkedin.health.disconnected_connected: A send or a read found the LinkedIn session lost. Check the status: once the provider says the account works, it is healthy again.
linkedin.health.manage_only: Only the account's owner, managing LinkedIn accounts, can check its status and resume it.
linkedin.health.rate: {rate, number, percent} of the last {sample, number} connection requests accepted
linkedin.health.rate_unknown: The acceptance rate needs 100 connection requests a week old
linkedin.health.resume_body: Whytide restarts this account at half its daily targets for connection requests and messages; they rise again day by day.
linkedin.health.resumed: Account resumed: its targets restart at half.
linkedin.health.title: Health
linkedin.health.todo.checkpoint: Pass LinkedIn's security check in LinkedIn, then disconnect this account and connect it again. Once the cool-down is over, check the status and resume.
linkedin.health.todo.restricted: Open LinkedIn and make sure the account works. Once the cool-down is over, check the status and resume.
linkedin.health.trigger.rate_limit_error: Three provider errors in an hour
linkedin.mail.account_paused.subject: {trigger, select, acceptance_rate {Whytide paused the connection requests of your LinkedIn account} other {Whytide paused your LinkedIn account}}
linkedin.mail.invites_paused.subject: Whytide paused the connection requests of every LinkedIn account on the instance
linkedin.page.description: The LinkedIn account Whytide reads profiles with: its status, working hours and daily read limit.
linkedin.page.title: LinkedIn
linkedin.read_limit.hint: A whole number from 1 to {max, number}.
linkedin.read_limit.warning: LinkedIn may restrict an account that views many profiles a day. 100 is the default.
linkedin.usage.actions_today: {used, number} of {max, number} actions today, reads included
linkedin.usage.invites_today: {used, number} of {limit, number} connection requests today
linkedin.usage.title: Today's limits
linkedin.usage.week_invites: {used, number} of {cap, number} connection requests in the past week
linkedin.usage.window_closed: Outside working hours: no reads now.
linkedin.usage.window_open: Inside working hours: reads may run now.
